notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
